metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel, somehow 2 enemies just vanished?! Valorant logic broke again
metadata.description:
Me: panic-clicking like I’m swatting flies

If your aim’s a lovable disaster, you’re not alone

Tap if your aim surprises even you!
